heuristic_reading: the release CPU target (-Dcpu=baseline) as the leading hypothesis for the target ratio
interpretation_limits: Pre-registered reading rule, kept as a diagnostic heuristic: target = M(cand)/M(native) and code = M(native)/M(50cbd80e) medians against the threshold max(2 %, noise). The threshold is not a confidence interval; a median inside it does not prove equivalence, one outside it does not prove a cause, and the rule cannot attribute the residual to run conditions - it only says the measured ratio difference is not separable from the round-to-round noise by this design. Same document = equal documents; token paths and masks were not recorded.
